summary: KE Holdings Inc. filed a Form 6-K to submit its 2025 Annual Report to the SEC. The filing is a routine foreign private issuer report under Rule 13a-16, attaching the annual report as an exhibit. There are no transaction terms, board recommendations, advisors, or structural mechanics discussed. The filing does not announce any special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other event-driven change. It is a standard periodic filing with no material corporate action. No deal terms exist; therefore, the analysis is not applicable.
